note: Hand-labelled ground truth for the anatomy section classifier. Each entry is one company's home page, with the correct type for each section as judged by a human reading the page. This file is the only thing that makes a published accuracy number checkable, which is why it lives in the repository rather than in a database: anyone can clone it, disagree with a label, and re-run scripts/score-anatomy.js to see what their disagreement costs.
keying: Sections are keyed by their heading text, not by position, because position changes whenever the classifier changes and a heading is the page's own words. The hero has no heading of its own and is keyed as the reserved string __hero__.
provenance: `by` records who made the judgement. `claude` labels were made by reading the extracted section text, never by looking at what the classifier said; they are still weaker evidence than a human label and are marked so that a reader can score against either set. `ruslan` labels are authoritative.
vocabulary_note: A label may use a type the classifier cannot currently produce. That is the point: a type that keeps appearing in the labels and never in the output is the vocabulary telling us what it is missing.
